437:t_3:51.en:
$n
「For now, let $$ＡＧ$$ keep going. Apparently, $$ジェミニオン・レイ$$ is something beyond even $$ＡＧ$$'s expectations.」

437:t_3:52.en:
$n
「In other words, not everything will go the way $$ＡＧ$$ wants.」

437:t_3:54.en:
$n
「Just seeing you panic made the birth of $$ジェミニオン・レイ$$ worthwhile.」

437:t_3:57.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「N-no... So none of you really trust me after all.」

437:t_3:58.en:
$$キラ$$
「Have you heard the saying... 'You reap what you sow'?」

437:t_3:59.en:
$$ノノ$$
「That's right. If you want trust, you should make sincerity and honesty your selling points every day.」

437:t_3:60.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「I'm terribly sorry. Our $$Ｄトレーダー$$ doesn't carry those products.」

437:t_3:62.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「At any rate, we now know $$ジェミニオン・レイ$$ is a mode that unlocks as $n's awareness rises.」

437:t_3:63.en:
$n
「So it works like $$ジェニオン$$ and $$ジェニオン・ガイ$$.」

437:t_3:64.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「You deploy in $$ジェニオン$$, then switch to $$ジェニオン・ガイ$$ and finish in $$ジェミニオン・レイ$$. It's a two-step transformation.」

437:t_3:65.en:
$n
「Got it. I'll master it, you can count on that.」

437:t_3:66.en:
$n
(I'll do it to save Miss $$スズネ$$ too...)

437:t_3:67.en:
$$アムロ$$
「That's enough talk. Everyone, take your stations.」

437:t_3:69.en:
$$アムロ$$
「$c is changing course and heading for $$翠の地球$$'s moon.」

437:t_3:70.en:
$$ロラン$$
「Captain $$アムロ$$... Does that mean...」

437:t_3:71.en:
$$アムロ$$
「Yes. Queen $$ディアナ$$ of the Moon has asked us for help.」

437:t_3:73.en:
$$ガロード$$
「The $$ムーンレィス$$ are fighting $$サイデリアル$$ too, right?」

437:t_3:74.en:
$$ロラン$$
「Yeah... But the Moon itself hasn't really been a target, so I don't think the fighting has been that intense...」

437:t_3:75.en:
$$ロラン$$
(Queen $$ディアナ$$... What on earth has happened on the Moon...?)

437:t_10:4.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「I actually meant '$$ジェミニオン$$': 'mi', meaning 'body', entering the 'gai', or shell, of $$ジェニオン・ガイ$$.」

437:t_10:5.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Well, that's fine... It wasn't what I expected, but if it's a stronger machine, I have no complaints.」

437:t_10:6.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「And $n will surely keep growing stronger through his battles with $$アムブリエル$$.」

437:t_10:7.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Today's two battles with $$アムブリエル$$ produced 100Z worth of $$Ｚチップ$$s. I'll add them to the team's stock.」

437:t_10:8.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「$$ジェミニオン・レイ$$... I wonder how much further it will grow...」

437:t_10:14.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「What is it, $n...? Do you still have more complaints?」

437:t_10:16.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「I'm untrustworthy, a chip miser, a sexual harassment robot; my dimension jokes stink; $$Ｄトレーダー$$ prices are too high...」

437:t_10:17.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「My legs are too short, I'm vulgar, I keep too many secrets, my advice is careless, I'm too wide and get in the way...」

437:t_10:18.en:
$n
「I wasn't planning to say any of that...」

437:t_10:20.en:
$n
「Since I have the chance, I thought I'd pick a complaint you haven't mentioned yet.」

437:t_10:23.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「People trying to stop being the quiet type really do tell lousy jokes.」

437:t_10:26.en:
$n
「I owe you thanks, $$ＡＧ$$. Because of you, I was able to fight again.」

437:t_10:28.en:
$n
「Come to think of it, we haven't had a chance to sit and talk like this since Miss $$スズネ$$ attacked...」

437:t_10:29.en:
$n
「This is a good chance, so I'll say it properly. Thank you, $$ＡＧ$$...」

437:t_10:31.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Then let's put that gratitude into words! Today, let's give it our all and...」

437:t_10:32.en:
$n
「That's the one thing I don't feel like saying.」

437:t_10:33.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Why not?! Every single member of $c except you, $n, has said it at least once!」

437:t_10:34.en:
$n
「Did $$宗介$$, $$ヒイロ$$, $$刹那$$ and $$キリコ$$ say it too?!」

437:t_10:36.en:
$n
「Did Captain $$クルーゾー$$, Lt. $$カナリア$$, $$ビヒーダ$$, $$シャッコ$$, Lt. Colonel $$マデューカス$$, Major $$グラハム$$ and XO $$レイアム$$ say it too?!」

437:t_10:37.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Yes... I managed to get them to say it by trying every trick in the book.」

437:t_10:38.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Which leaves only you, $n! Come on! Show your gratitude!」

437:t_10:39.en:
$n
「No matter how much you ask, that's the one thing I absolutely refuse to say!!」

438:t_000:0.en:
$$テッサ$$
「What type of enemy is it?」

438:t_000:1.en:
$$マデューカス$$
「Unidentified, but since they aren't broadcasting a friendly ID signal, we should regard them as hostile.」

438:t_000:2.en:
$$竜馬$$
「So they're trying to stop us from reaching $$蒼の地球$$.」

438:t_000:3.en:
$$シモン$$
「Then they're probably $$サイデリアル$$.」

438:t_000:4.en:
$$葵$$
「I'll cut loose no matter who we're fighting. That's the mood I'm in.」

438:t_000:5.en:
$$テッサ$$
(Morale is high, just as $$相良$$ said...)

438:t_000:7.en:
$$ノノ$$
「Huh...? I don't see $$クロウ$$ here.」

438:t_000:8.en:
$$チコ$$
「If you mean the guy in debt, $$ＡＧ$$ stopped him for a chat.」

438:t_000:9.en:
$$デュオ$$
「Don't tell me... He borrowed money from $$ＡＧ$$ too?」

438:t_000:10.en:
$$アレルヤ$$
「If so, he really has no scruples when it comes to money.」

438:t_000:11.en:
$$ピーリス$$
(You're as harsh on $$クロウ$$ as ever...)

438:t_001:1.en:
$$アスカ$$
「How suicidal do you have to be to charge straight into close range?!」

438:t_001:2.en:
$$マリ$$
「Then let's finish them off already.」

438:t_001:3.en:
$$テッサ$$
「There aren't many of them. All units, coordinate your attacks to destroy the enemy.」

438:t_001:4.en:
$$竜馬$$
「You bastards picked the perfect time to show up. I'm taking my frustration out on you today.」

438:t_001:5.en:
$$ランド$$
「I'm with you, $$竜馬$$! Let's smash them to pieces today!」

438:t_001:6.en:
$$メール$$
「You're joining in just to vent your anger...? That's awful...」

438:t_001:7.en:
$$竜馬$$
「Here we come, $$インベーダー#robot$$s! Sorry, but we're in a foul mood!」
